variety.comparison: Set A varies CTA objects, materials, palettes and typography per motif (exit sign, seal stamp, flag banner, elevator dial, amber, DQ window) and keeps only a shared layout skeleton, whereas set B is one candy-sticker template (tilted yellow pill + mascot + rainbow emoji tile dock) recoloured per theme.
